description: This file manages CANopen storage operations, including saving, erasing, and restoring object dictionary data to non-volatile memory, and handles configuration settings related to CANopen storage.

methods.name: canopen_odf_1010
methods.description: Handles Object Dictionary Store Parameter function, saving ROM entries when triggered.

methods.name: canopen_odf_1011
methods.description: Handles Object Dictionary Restore Parameter function, erasing ROM and EEPROM entries when triggered.

methods.name: canopen_settings_set
methods.description: Sets configuration data for EEPROM and ROM object dictionaries based on stored settings.

methods.name: canopen_storage_attach
methods.description: Attaches storage handlers to SDO and reports errors if any.

methods.name: canopen_storage_save
methods.description: Saves specified storage (ROM or EEPROM) to non-volatile memory.

methods.name: canopen_storage_erase
methods.description: Erases specified storage (ROM or EEPROM) from non-volatile memory.
